prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a high fidelity visual design approval board for LUMA Hub V1, a real French personal workspace connected to Kyros identity. This is an IMAGE MOCKUP, not code, not an actual product screenshot. 1536x1024 landscape or higher equivalent. Design board: large desktop screen occupying left 75%, one distinct mobile screen right 25%. Slim top board caption "LUMA Hub · A — Dashboard" and tiny "Maquette · données illustratives". Desktop uses a warm light neutral canvas #f4f5f2, white surfaces, near-black typography, dark petroleum #174f51 interactive accent, restrained amber #b77929 highlights, sharp 10px corners, crisp 1px lines, spacious precisely aligned professional productivity UI. A 200px left sidebar: LUMA wordmark and restrained geometric L, "Personnel" workspace selector, navigation "Workspace" selected, "Applications", "Favoris", "Récents", "Personnaliser", lower account area "Compte Kyros". Main header thin full-width with search "Rechercher une application…", keyboard hint "⌘ K", avatar. Main content heading "Mon workspace", supporting "Un espace à votre rythme." right-side buttons "Personnaliser" and "Ajouter un widget". Main grid 3 columns: a horizontal favorites section left two columns containing application links BrainDump, Drivio, Nino, Harmonix represented by tasteful simple official-inspired monograms, name + small access arrow only, no fake counts or statuses; right column live clock native widget 09:41 and "Mercredi 18 novembre". Below: month calendar "Novembre 2026" actual clean day grid with current day 18 marked; shortcuts native widget "Raccourcis" with simple URL links "Mon compte Kyros", "Applications"; small recent accesses list. Each widget has unobtrusive ellipsis and small descriptive title; no fake tasks, meetings, weather, music playback or infrastructure metrics. Show enough native content that this is a practical workspace rather than marketing. Subtle status "Enregistré" in footer. MOBILE must be a distinct dark system theme app screen, deep charcoal teal #131b1d, ivory text, same accent adapted, top brand and avatar, title "Mon espace", thumb-friendly search, clock/date compact strip, two-column favorite app launcher and compact calendar widget in single stack, fixed bottom nav "Espace", "Apps", "Favoris", "Réglages". 44px minimum touch targets. No shrunken sidebar on mobile. Match typography and icon family across light and dark. No huge hero, no gradient purple, no glass, no floating 3D device mockups, no ornamental charts. Flat straight-on screens on simple board, readable French typography. Commit to high craft, restrained editorial hierarchy and functional dense content.
